answer: The tundra detector writes to violet, and marble shows every merge. A farm scripting its whole farm fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 74 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. Submissions that land within 155 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. That is 30 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
